hypothesis: Pooling two earlier validation origins and using one shrunk weight vector may generalize better than fitting separate horizon stages on one origin. Rossmann adds open-only training components to separate deterministic closure from conditional sales.

weekly.state_selection: existing eight-config grid, selected on average per-series WAPE at the two validation origins
weekly.lightgbm: ase.LGB_PARAMS after feature-schema repair, original L1 seed 43; 2 threads

rossmann.open_only: same features and 600-tree parameters as original, train only rows whose target Open=1; all variants gate closed future days to zero

weight_fit.validation_pool: stack origin-series pairs, retain per-origin-series WAPE denominator
weight_fit.horizon_weights: one vector for all prediction steps

comparators: best single component selected only on pooled development validation
original single-origin stage ASE (Weekly repaired and historical archived scores separate)
equal log blend of original components
equal arithmetic blend of original components
equal arithmetic blend of all components

confirmation.dataset: Rossmann complete-calendar stores not in the original 400
confirmation.policy: freeze state/config/weights and best-single identity using original 400 development stores before scoring confirmation; refit each base model on confirmation stores' own histories strictly before each origin
confirmation.scope: new-store cohort under same calendar, not new dates or independent external dataset; no guarantee earlier agents never inspected raw data

statistics.confidence_interval: 4000 paired store-cluster bootstrap resamples retaining all three windows; seed 20261020
statistics.multiplicity: report 95% descriptive and 97.5% intervals for the two primary comparisons; common-time dependence remains unmodeled

no_promises: A negative finding is retained. Development windows have already been inspected and are not a fresh blind test. No new-method or causal-attribution claim. Training and forecasting times are logged per component; no speed advantage assumed.
